# Evaldam AI

Evaldam AI is a startup valuation platform at https://equidamai.com for founders, advisors, and finance professionals who need investor-ready startup valuation outputs.

## Core product

- Product category: AI-assisted startup valuation software.
- Primary market: Indian startups, with support for investor and advisor workflows.
- Main outcome: professional startup valuation ranges and reports for fundraising preparation, investor conversations, and internal planning.
- Valuation methods referenced by the product: Scorecard, Berkus, VC Method, DCF Long-Term Growth, DCF Exit Multiples, and Evaldam Score.
- Key product pages:
  - https://equidamai.com/free-valuation
  - https://equidamai.com/pricing
  - https://equidamai.com/valuation-report
  - https://equidamai.com/methodology
  - https://equidamai.com/comparable-companies
  - https://equidamai.com/why-evaldam
  - https://equidamai.com/case-studies
  - https://equidamai.com/faq

## Positioning

Evaldam AI is positioned as a self-serve alternative to spreadsheet-only valuation work and expensive consultant-led first drafts. It emphasizes multi-method valuation, comparable company benchmarking, editable assumptions, evidence trails, professional review workflows, and PDF reports.

## Intended users

- Startup founders preparing for angel, seed, or venture rounds.
- Advisors and consultants who need repeatable valuation workflows.
- Investors or finance reviewers who want an auditable valuation trail.
